issue.title: Split sase-core bead_event_parity.rs and agent_scan_parity.rs integration tests into <=1500 line single-binary trees
issue.description:
PROPOSED BY sase-15b.10 (note #1), last phase of epic sase-15b ("Split The Next Ten Largest sase-core Rust Files Into <=1500 Line Modules"), triaged by the sase-15b land agent.

Two sase-core Cargo integration-test files are still over the 1500-line file-size invariant that epics sase-14s and sase-15b enforce for every Rust file, test code included:

- crates/sase_core/tests/bead_event_parity.rs: 2,182 lines
- crates/sase_core/tests/agent_scan_parity.rs: 2,139 lines

(measured with `find crates -name '*.rs' -not -path '*/target/*' -exec wc -l {} + | sort -rn | awk '$1 > 1500'` at sase-core master 8886406)

Remediation: split each one exactly the way sase-15b.10 split tests/notification_store_parity.rs (commit 8886406). Turn it into a single test binary, `tests/<name>/main.rs` plus sibling behavior-area modules and a shared `support.rs`. Do NOT fan it out into several top-level tests/*.rs binaries, because each extra binary re-links sase_core and slows every `just check`. Move tests verbatim. Keep the per-binary `#[test]` count identical before and after (check with `cargo test -p sase_core --test <name> -- --list`). Fix any `include_str!`/fixture paths, which resolve one directory deeper after the move. Run `just check` from the sase-core root.

task_type_fields.proposal: Split crates/sase_core/tests/bead_event_parity.rs (2,182 lines) and crates/sase_core/tests/agent_scan_parity.rs (2,139 lines) into single-binary tests/<name>/main.rs + sibling-module trees with no file over 1500 lines, mirroring sase-15b.10's notification_store_parity split.
task_type_fields.why_out_of_scope: Epic sase-15b targeted a fixed list of ten files chosen at audit time; these two were below that cut, and phase workers were told not to split untargeted files. They were already oversized before the epic; it did not cause them.
